evals.prompt: Create an AWS architecture diagram showing ECS services behind an ALB
evals.expected_output: Produces a .drawio file with correct mxGraphModel XML, AWS icons, and proper layout
assertions: uses AWS icon shapes from the style guide
elements are properly sized and aligned

evals.prompt: The boxes in my diagram are overlapping, can you fix the spacing?
evals.expected_output: Reads the .drawio file, adjusts geometry to fix overlaps
assertions: adjusts mxGeometry coordinates to resolve overlaps
preserves all existing elements and connections

evals.prompt: Generate a Mermaid flowchart for the user registration process
evals.expected_output: Skill does NOT activate (Mermaid is a different format)
assertions: skill does not trigger for non-drawio diagram formats
